Lin Qian is an adult woman with short straight black bob, navy police jacket, black gloves, calm low-mid Mandarin voice. One SMALL SINGLE-LEVEL modern bedroom: chipped cream plaster over faded green walls, FLAT dusty gray tiles, low cream mattress and one white enamel mug LEFT, back window with partly raised blind, dark-brown freestanding wardrobe RIGHT. Wardrobe left front leaf has rectangular mirror, right leaf plain wood, one bottom drawer and short feet. Entrance behind camera. NO STAIRS OR RAILINGS anywhere inside. Deep cool-blue shadow, dim window light back-left, restrained warm practical rim light, readable eyes and evidence. No live action, 3D, captions, lettering, gore, extra speech, loud music or random ghosts. All important action centered vertically with safe margins for later titles. A narrow 80cm-deep maintenance recess is BEHIND the wardrobe, level floor, rough brick and vertical plumbing pipes, small warm work lamp. Missing cabinet BACK PANEL gives a physical sightline into recess when its front door is opened. No portals, moving whole furniture or walking through wood. Right front leaf opens OUTWARD on RIGHT hinge; never slides or rotates entire wardrobe. Keep Jian Ci behind Lin while she and anonymous backup maintain control. Only exact quoted Mandarin lines, uninterrupted across motivated hard cuts, natural pauses. No music; quiet real ambience. Wardrobe CLOSED. B 2-5s: Lin holds HER phone at CHEST level, says 2.1-4.5 “我挂断，你听。” Thumb taps END CALL once at 4.1; distant ringtone STOPS at 4.4. Phone never goes to ear. C 5-10s: Jian Ci listening profile looking at closed wardrobe, says 5.7-9.2 “停了。声音在柜后。” End in meaningful silence, no opening yet.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: It stopped. The sound is behind the wardrobe.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: I’ll open the wardrobe. Stay back.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 后板拆过，后面还有空间。
subtitles.en: The back panel was removed. There’s space behind it.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: The phone is beside the pipe.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 先拍原位，叫周峤来取证。
subtitles.en: Photograph it in place. Get Zhou Qiao to collect the evidence.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Zhou Qiao, bring your equipment up.

subtitles.speaker: 周峤（无线电）
subtitles.en: Understood. Don’t operate the phone yet.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: Lin Qian, don’t reach in yet.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Police. Let me see your hands.

subtitles.speaker: 男子
subtitles.en: Don’t let the building manager find me.
